title: Nebraska AI Laws

reading.body:
Nebraska's only AI-related law is a 2026 act that pairs agricultural data privacy with safety duties for conversational AI.

The pattern is a single statute carrying two unrelated subjects. One half governs data from farms, land, devices, and equipment, giving producers ownership and control, barring sale without express written consent, and requiring reasonable security. The other half regulates conversational AI services through disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties, with particular attention to minor account holders. The public records amendment lets agricultural data be withheld absent prior written consent from its owner.

For AI specifically, the operative part is the conversational services title. It places duties on operators rather than on the compute, buildings, or power that run those services, so nothing here constrains data center siting, electricity procurement, or hardware. The agricultural provisions touch data rather than infrastructure. A reader looking for grid or compute obligations will not find them in this law.

What the data does not cover is equally clear. It is one law, passed 2026-04-17, and it says nothing about how the duties are enforced, what penalties attach, or whether any operator has changed behavior. It also does not show Nebraska's full legislative output on AI, only the bills this site judged relevant. One law is a thin basis for characterizing a state's posture.

Nebraska has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Nebraska

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • LB525: Adopt the Agricultural Data Privacy Act and the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act passed 2026-04-17

    The law adopts the Agricultural Data Privacy Act, which gives agricultural producers ownership and control of agricultural data originating from their farm, land, devices, and equipment, and prohibits controllers and processors from selling that data without express written consent while requiring reasonable data security. It also adopts the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act, which imposes disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties on operators of conversational artificial intelligence services, especially for minor account holders. It amends the public records law to allow withholding agricultural data absent prior written consent from the owner.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Nebraska. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
